resources.string: Import assets into this project library, add them as layers, or select a media layer and set held replacement keys. Works in the main editor. Videos restart and loop at each replacement key.
Your project library is empty. Import images, videos or audio.

Create a root bone, then child bones. Select artwork in the timeline, reopen this tab, choose a bone and bind it. Animate rotation with keys or solve a two-bone chain with IK. Bone length sets the attachment point for NEW children; move existing joints with Transform. Rigid cutout rigs, without mesh deformation.
Animate with keyframes (off replaces the whole track)
Selected artwork layers: %1$d. Binding preserves their current animation and placement.
IK target X/Y is relative to the parent bone origin in its parent coordinate system. Use an unscaled chain with its child joint at (parent length, 0). Unreachable targets are clamped.

Save the selected rig and all connected layers, or the whole scene when nothing is selected. Media is copied with the model. Inserted models are independent editable groups: open the group to edit bones and artwork.
IK requires unit scale, no skew, and a child joint at (parent length, 0). Restore the rest pose or correct Transform first.
Choose media. + opens your gallery. ◆ creates a replacement key.
Tap ◆ at this frame, then choose media for the new key.
Select artwork in the viewport. Drag to draw and bind a bone, or tap an existing bone. Start at a joint to continue a chain.
Drag a bone tip to pose the artwork; drag a root joint to move the rig. Pinch to zoom. Save through My resources.
